maddeler.e:
نتأرجح (form IIq)
# نَتَأَرْجَحُ (nataʔarjaḥu) /na.ta.ʔar.d͡ʒa.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
# نَتَأَرْجَحَ (nataʔarjaḥa) /na.ta.ʔar.d͡ʒa.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
# نَتَأَرْجَحْ (nataʔarjaḥ) /na.ta.ʔar.d͡ʒaħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
